name: qm-socket-proxy
description: Dedicated authenticated Docker API proxy required by Quartermaster Companion. It keeps the Docker socket out of the main application and does not publish a host port.

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Docker socket used by the restricted proxy. Keep this mount read only.

variables.name: Proxy key
variables.description: Shared key used to authenticate Companion. Generate it with openssl rand -hex 32 and enter the same value in qm-companion.

variables.name: Docker writes
variables.description: Keep 0 for read only. Set 1 only when qm-companion uses the manage or shell access level.

variables.name: Container shell
variables.description: Keep 0 unless qm-companion uses the shell access level.

variables.name: Events API
variables.description: Allows Companion to follow Docker events.

variables.name: Host information API
variables.description: Allows Companion to read Docker host information.

variables.name: Disk usage API
variables.description: Allows Companion to read Docker disk usage.

variables.name: Ping API
variables.description: Allows Companion to check the Docker connection.

variables.name: Version API
variables.description: Allows Companion to read the Docker API version.
